enrich.rationale: Residual-UCB active learning will concentrate new solves where the current winner demonstrably errs (and a bit beyond), yielding more RMSE reduction per added sample than blind resampling or additional hyperparameter search.

diagnosis: RMSE is still primarily limited by insufficient/uneven sample coverage in specific input directions (r0, a, kappa, delta, Ip) producing structured residuals, with stable validation across seeds.
